Teaching & Astronomy Outreach

Panelist, Star-Gazing Lecture

Engaged with the community and communicated astronomy research in an accessible way, contributing to public science outreach through interactive discussions and Q&A on radio astronomy, the DSA-2000 survey, and the science of the night sky.

International Center for Theoretical Sciences (ICTS), TIFR

Lecturer, FTSky Workshop

Led an intensive hands-on training session on optical studies of FRB host galaxies. Designed and delivered lectures and tutorials on archival data mining, data reduction, probabilistic host-galaxy association, optical spectroscopy, and SED modeling, guiding participants through real astronomical analysis workflows.

AUDIENCE — 100+ graduate students
